why
Row 1 · ★ SWING rulebook
Stop 1.25× ATR · R:R 3.0 · FRESH/PULLBACK · ER ≥14d · Kelly ×1.0 · "Setup-driven…"
Deleted
Content moved into ⚡ SWING button tooltip
These are constants of the strategy, not ticker-specific. They never change between tickers — they only change when the user switches mode. A permanent row was always wasted real estate. Tooltip = reference info on demand.
Row 2 · PER-STRATEGY DECISION CARD
$239.96 / $227.57 / $302.55 / $341.67 · R:R 1:3.6
Folded into Line 1 PLAN
PLAN re-renders with strategy-adjusted values when mode is clicked
The card showed different numbers than Line 1 — the canonical PLAN was one step behind the strategy. Now Line 1 IS the per-strategy plan. Single source of truth.
Row 3 · ⚠ PRE-MORTEM
"No falsification criteria on this payload…" full paragraph
Slim banner · auto-hide friendly
3 falsification bullets inline · empty-state nudge when unwired
Kept — principle 4 (adversarial mindset, every claim has falsification). Just compacted: 50px row → 28px slim banner.

−34% header height · 3 callouts → 1 conditional banner
The ticker bar becomes an interactive trade ticket: click ⚡/📅/🏛 and the PLAN + ladder + R-multiples all re-bind. Mode buttons gain real responsibility.
